overview: The NLG8520 by Nebulae is a cutting-edge Wi-SUN gateway that provides secured interconnection of Wi-SUN field devices with WAN communication networks. Its capabilities include Wi-SUN FAN 1.0 support, remote device management, communication management, data storage and interface abstraction.

A choice of multiple WAN interfaces (LTE cellular, Ethernet, RS485) and mounting options makes it suitable for different deployment strategies and locations. It is ideal for small to medium mesh networks supporting up to 250 nodes on a single network for various IoT applications.

It runs an open-source embedded Linux system (Yocto Linux sumo) on an A5D2X Cortex-A5 at 500 MHz, supports RF self-healing and self-forming networks, secure firmware update and NTP, and is housed in an IP65 fire-retardant case with tamper protection and an external 5 dBi fibre-glass antenna.
